department: Fariborz Maseeh Department of Civil, Architectural and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: Fall applications are due December 1 (2026 for Fall 2027); materials may follow after this priority date but early submission is strongly advised.
deadline.quote: Fall/Summer due December 1; Spring due September 1

also.quote: Applications for fall admission are due December 1 each year.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required for admission or funding.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required for admission or funding consideration.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants pick a research area on the application; the pages checked do not say whether a supervisor is needed before admission.

funding.value: Admitted students are automatically considered for available research/teaching assistantships and fellowships (fellowships are competitive); no blanket funding guarantee is stated.
funding.quote: All eligible admitted graduate students are automatically considered for any available funding—there is no separate application for aid consideration.

entry_route.value: The pages checked accept many undergraduate backgrounds but do not say whether a master's is expected for the PhD.

notes: The Civil Engineering PhD is the umbrella for all CAEE research areas, including environmental and water resources engineering.
